verses.text: All di congregation lift up dem voice, and cry. Di people weep dat night.
All di pikin dem of Israel complain against Moses and against Aaron. Di whole congregation talk to dem, “We for don die for di land of Egypt! Or we for don die for dis wilderness!
Why di Lord dey bring us to dis land, to fall by di sword? Our wives and our little ones go be prey. E no go better for us to return to Egypt?”
Dem talk to one another, “Make we appoint one leader, and return to Egypt.”
Moses and Aaron fall on dem faces before all di assembly of di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel.
Joshua di pikin of Nun, and Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh, wey be of dem wey spy out di land, tear dem clothes.
Dem speak to all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel, talk, “Di land, through wey we pass to spy am out, na one exceedingly good land.
If di Lord delight for us, e go bring us into dis land, and give am to us, one land wey dey flow with milk and honey.
Only no rebel against di Lord, neither fear di people of di land, because dem na bread for us. Dem protection don depart from dem, and di Lord dey with us. No fear dem.”
But all di congregation talk to stone dem with stones. Di glory of di Lord appear for di Tent of Meeting to all di pikin dem of Israel.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “How long dis people go despise me? How long dem no go believe me, for all di signs wey I don do among dem?
I go strike dem with di pestilence, and disinherit dem, and I go make of you one nation greater and mightier pass dem.”
Moses talk to di Lord, “Di Egyptians go hear am, because you bring up dis people in your might from among dem,

and dem go tell am to di inhabitants of dis land. Dem don hear say you, di Lord, dey among dis people, say you, di Lord, dey seen face to face, and your cloud stand over dem, and you go before dem, by day for one pillar of cloud, and for one pillar of fire by night.
Now if you kill dis people as one man, di nations wey don hear di fame of you go talk,
‘Because di Lord no dey able to bring dis people into di land wey e swear to dem, na why e don kill dem for di wilderness.’
Now make di power of di Lord dey great, as you don speak, talk,

‘Di Lord dey slow to anger, and abundant for lovingkindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience, and e by no means go clear di guilty, visiting di iniquity of di papa dem on di pikin dem, on di third and on di fourth generation.’
Pardon di iniquity of dis people according to di greatness of your lovingkindness, and as you don forgive dis people, from Egypt even until now.”
Di Lord talk, “I don pardon according to your word.
But truly, as I live, all di earth go dey filled with di glory of di Lord.
Because all dem men wey don see my glory, and my signs, wey I do for Egypt and for di wilderness, yet don test me now dis ten times, and no listen to my voice,
surely dem no go see di land wey I swear to dem papa dem, neither go any of dem wey despise me see am.
But my servant Caleb, because im get one different spirit with am, and don follow me fully, I go bring am into di land wia e go, and im seed go possess am.
Now di Amalekites and di Canaanites dey dwell for di valley. Tomorrow turn, and go into di wilderness by di way to di Red Sea.”
Di Lord speak to Moses and to Aaron, talk,
“How long I go bear dis evil congregation, wey dey murmur against me? I don hear di murmurings of di pikin dem of Israel, wey dem murmur against me.
Tell dem say, ‘As I live, na so di Lord talk: surely as una don speak for my ears, so I go do to una.
Una dead bodies go fall for dis wilderness, and all wey dem number of una, according to all di number of una, from 20 years old and above, wey don murmur against me.
Surely una no go come into di land, concerning wey I swear to make una dwell inside am, except Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh, and Joshua di pikin of Nun.
But una little ones, wey una talk say go be prey, I go bring dem in, and dem go know di land wey una don reject.
But as for una, una dead bodies go fall for dis wilderness.
Una pikin dem go be shepherds for di wilderness 40 years, and go bear una unfaithfulness, until una dead bodies dey consumed for di wilderness.
After di number of di days in wey una spy out di land, even 40 days, each day for one year, una go bear una iniquity, even 40 years, and una go know my alienation.
I, di Lord, don speak. Surely dis I go do to all dis evil congregation, wey don gather demself together against me. For dis wilderness dem go dey consumed, and dere dem go die.’”
Di men wey Moses send to spy out di land, wey return and make all di congregation murmur against am, by bringing up one evil report against di land,
even dem men wey bring up di evil report of di land, die by di plague before di Lord.
But Joshua di pikin of Nun, and Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh, remain alive of dem men wey go to spy out di land.
Moses tell dem words to all di pikin dem of Israel, and di people mourn greatly.
Dem rise up early for morning, and go up to di top of di mountain, talk, “Look, we dey here, and we go go up to di place wey di Lord don promise, because we don sin.”
Moses talk, “Why now una dey disobey di commandment of di Lord, since e no go prosper?
No go up, because di Lord no dey among una, so that una no go dey struck down before una enemies.
Because di Amalekites and di Canaanites dey dere before una, and una go fall by di sword, because una don turn away from following di Lord, and di Lord no go dey with una.”
But dem dey presumptuous to go up to di top of di mountain. Nevertheless di ark of di covenant of di Lord, and Moses, no depart out of di camp.
Di Amalekites come down, and di Canaanites wey dwell for dat mountain, and strike dem, and beat dem down, even to Hormah.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘When una don come into di land of una habitations, wey I give una,

and make one offering made by fire to di Lord, one burnt offering, or one sacrifice, to accomplish one vow, or for one free will offering, or for una set feasts, to make one pleasing aroma to di Lord, of di herd, or of di flock,
im wey offer im offering go offer to di Lord one meal offering of one tenth of one ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of one hin of oil.
Una go prepare wine for di drink offering, one fourth of one hin, with di burnt offering or di sacrifice, for each lamb.
For one ram, una go prepare for one meal offering two tenths of one ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, one third of one hin.
For di drink offering una go offer one third of one hin of wine, for pleasing aroma to di Lord.
When una prepare one bull for one burnt offering, or for one sacrifice, to accomplish one vow, or for peace offerings to di Lord,
una go offer with di bull one meal offering of three tenths of one ephah of fine flour mixed with half one hin of oil.
Una go offer for di drink offering half one hin of wine, for one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord.
Na so e go dey done for each bull, or for each ram, or for each of di male lambs, or of di young goats.
According to di number wey una go prepare, so una go do to every one according to dem number.
All wey dey native born go do dem things in dis way, in offering one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma, to di Lord.
If one stranger dey sojourn with una, or whoever dey among una throughout una generations, and e want to offer one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma, to di Lord, as una do, so e go do.
For di assembly, una go get one statute, both for una and for di stranger wey dey sojourn. E go be one statute forever throughout una generations. As una dey, so di stranger go dey before di Lord.
One law and one ordinance go dey for una and for di stranger wey dey sojourn with una.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘When una come into di land wia I dey bring una,
e go be, when una eat of di bread of di land, say una go offer up one heave offering to di Lord.
Of di first of una dough una go offer up one cake for one heave offering. As e dey for di heave offering of di threshing floor, so una go heave am.
Of di first of una dough una go give to di Lord one heave offering throughout una generations.
When una go err, and no observe all dem commandments, wey di Lord don speak to Moses,
even all wey di Lord don command una by di hand of Moses, from di day wey di Lord give commandment, and onward throughout una generations,

if e dey done by error, without di knowledge of di congregation, all di congregation go offer one young bull for one burnt offering, for pleasing aroma to di Lord, with im meal offering, and im drink offering, according to di ordinance, and one male goat for one sin offering.

Di priest go make atonement for all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel, and dem go dey forgiven, because e na error. Dem go bring dem offering, one offering made by fire to di Lord, and dem sin offering before di Lord, for dem error.
All di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel go dey forgiven, and di stranger wey dey sojourn among dem, because all di people dey in error.
If one person sin through error, e go offer one female goat of di first year for one sin offering.
Di priest go make atonement for di soul wey err, when e sin through error, before di Lord, to make atonement for am, and e go dey forgiven.
Una go get one law for am wey do anything through error, for am wey dey native born among di pikin dem of Israel, and for di stranger wey dey sojourn among dem.
But di soul wey do anything with one high hand, whether e be native or stranger, di same blaspheme di Lord. Dat soul go dey cut off from among im people.
Because e don despise di word of di Lord, and don break im commandment, dat soul go surely dey cut off. Im iniquity go dey on am.’”
While di pikin dem of Israel dey for di wilderness, dem find one man gathering sticks on di Sabbath day.
Dem wey find am gathering sticks bring am to Moses and Aaron, and to all di congregation.
Dem put am in custody, because e no dey declared wetin dem go do to am.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Di man go surely dey put to death. All di congregation go stone am with stones outside di camp.”
All di congregation bring am outside di camp, and stone am to death with stones, as di Lord command Moses.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem say make dem make tassels for di corners of dem garments throughout dem generations, and put for di tassel of each corner one cord of blue.

E go be to una for one tassel, so that when una look at am, una go remember all di commandments of di Lord, and do dem, and no follow una own heart and una own eyes, after wey una dey used to play di prostitute.
So una go remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to una God.
I na di Lord una God, wey bring una out of di land of Egypt, to be una God. I na di Lord una God.”
Now Korah, di pikin of Izhar, di pikin of Kohath, di pikin of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, di pikin man dem of Eliab, and On di pikin of Peleth, pikin man dem of Reuben, take men.
Dem rise up before Moses, with some of di pikin dem of Israel, 250 princes of di congregation, called to di assembly, men of renown.

Dem assemble demself together against Moses and against Aaron, and talk to dem, “Una take too much on una, seeing say all di congregation dey holy, everyone of dem, and di Lord dey among dem. Why una lift una selves up above di assembly of di Lord?”
When Moses hear am, e fall on im face.

E speak to Korah and to all im company, talk, “Tomorrow morning di Lord go show who dey im own, and who dey holy, and go cause am to come near to am. Even am wey e don choose go e cause to come near to am.
Do dis: take censers, Korah, and all im company.
Put fire inside dem, and put incense on dem before di Lord tomorrow. Di man wey di Lord choose, na im go dey holy. Una take too much on una, una pikin dem of Levi!”
Moses talk to Korah, “Hear now, una pikin dem of Levi:

e small thing to una, say di God of Israel don separate una from di congregation of Israel, to bring una near to imself, to do di service of di tabernacle of di Lord, and to stand before di congregation to minister to dem,
and e don bring you near, and all your brothers di pikin dem of Levi with you? Una seek di priesthood also?
Therefore you and all your company dey gathered together against di Lord. Wetin Aaron be, say una murmur against am?”
Moses send to call Dathan and Abiram, di pikin man dem of Eliab, but dem talk, “We no go come up.
E small thing say you don bring us up out of one land wey dey flow with milk and honey, to kill us for di wilderness, but you must make yourself ruler over us?
Moreover you no bring us into one land wey dey flow with milk and honey, nor give us inheritance of fields and vineyards. You go put out di eyes of dem men? We no go come up.”
Moses dey very angry, and talk to di Lord, “No respect dem offering. I no take one donkey from dem, neither I hurt any one of dem.”
Moses talk to Korah, “You and all your company, make una dey before di Lord tomorrow, you, and dem, and Aaron.
Make every man take im censer, and put incense on dem, and every man bring before di Lord im censer, 250 censers. You too, and Aaron, each im censer.”
Dem take every man im censer, and put fire for dem, and lay incense on dem, and stand for di door of di Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.
Korah gather all di congregation against dem to di door of di Tent of Meeting. Di glory of di Lord appear to all di congregation.
Di Lord speak to Moses and to Aaron, talk,
“Separate yourselves from among dis congregation, so that I go consume dem for one moment.”
Dem fall on dem faces, and talk, “God, di God of di spirits of all flesh, one man go sin, and you go dey angry with all di congregation?”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di congregation, talk, ‘Get away from around di tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.’”
Moses rise up and go to Dathan and Abiram, and di elders of Israel follow am.
E speak to di congregation, talk, “Depart now from di tents of dem wicked men, and no touch anything of dem, otherwise una go dey consumed for all dem sins.”
So dem get up from di tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram come out, and stand for di door of dem tents, with dem wives, and dem pikin man dem, and dem little ones.
Moses talk, “By dis una go know say di Lord don send me to do all dem works, and say e no be from my own mind.
If dem men die as all men die, or if dem dey visited after di visitation of all men, di Lord no send me.
But if di Lord make one new thing, and di ground open im mouth, and swallow dem up, with all wey belong to dem, and dem go down alive into Sheol, una go understand say dem men don despise di Lord.”
E come be say, as e finish speaking all dem words, di ground wey dey under dem split apart.
Di earth open im mouth, and swallow dem up, and dem houses, and all di men wey belong to Korah, and all dem goods.
So dem, and all wey belong to dem, go down alive into Sheol. Di earth close on dem, and dem perish from among di assembly.
All Israel wey dey round dem flee at di cry of dem, because dem talk, “Make di earth no swallow us up!”
Fire come out from di Lord, and consume di 250 men wey offer di incense.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to Eleazar di pikin of Aaron di priest, say make e take up di censers out of di burning, and scatter di fire far away, because dem dey holy,

even di censers of dem wey sin against dem own souls. Make dem make dem into beaten plates for covering of di altar, because dem offer dem before di Lord, and dem dey holy. Dem go be one sign to di pikin dem of Israel.”
Eleazar di priest take di bronze censers, wey di men wey dem burn don offer, and dem beat dem out for covering of di altar,

to be one memorial to di pikin dem of Israel, so that no stranger, wey no be of di seed of Aaron, go come near to burn incense before di Lord, so that e no go be like Korah and im company, as di Lord speak to am by di hand of Moses.
But on di next day all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel murmur against Moses and against Aaron, talk, “You don kill di Lord people.”
E come be say, when di congregation dey gathered against Moses and against Aaron, dem look toward di Tent of Meeting, and look, di cloud cover am, and di glory of di Lord appear.
Moses and Aaron come to di front of di Tent of Meeting.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Get away from among dis congregation, so that I go consume dem for one moment.” Dem fall on dem faces.

Moses talk to Aaron, “Take your censer, and put fire on am from off di altar, and lay incense on am, and carry am quickly to di congregation, and make atonement for dem, because wrath don go out from di Lord. Di plague don begin.”
Aaron take as Moses speak, and run into di middle of di assembly, and look, di plague don begin among di people. E put on di incense, and make atonement for di people.
E stand between di dead and di living, and di plague dey stopped.
Now dem wey die by di plague na 14,700, besides dem wey die about di matter of Korah.
Aaron return to Moses at di door of di Tent of Meeting, and di plague dey stopped.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and take from dem every one one rod, according to dem papa houses, from all dem princes according to dem papa houses, 12 rods. Write every man name on im rod.
You go write Aaron name on di rod of Levi, because dere go be one rod for each head of dem papa houses.
You go lay dem up for di Tent of Meeting before di testimony, wia I meet with una.
E go happen say di man wey I choose, im rod go bud. I go make cease from me di murmurings of di pikin dem of Israel, wey dem murmur against una.”
Moses speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and all dem princes give am one rod each, for each prince one, according to dem papa houses, even 12 rods. Aaron rod dey among dem rods.
Moses lay up di rods before di Lord for di Tent of di testimony.
E come be say on di next day, Moses go into di Tent of di testimony, and look, Aaron rod for di house of Levi don bud, and bring forth buds, and blossom blossoms, and yield ripe almonds.
Moses bring out all di rods from before di Lord to all di pikin dem of Israel. Dem look, and dem take every man im rod.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Bring Aaron rod again before di testimony, to dey kept for one sign against di rebels. You go make one end of dem murmurings against me, so that dem no go die.”
Moses do so. As di Lord command am, so e do.
Di pikin dem of Israel speak to Moses, talk, “Look, we die! We perish! We all perish!
Anyone wey come near to di tabernacle of di Lord dey die. We go all die?”

Di Lord talk to Aaron, “You and your pikin man dem and your papa house with you go bear di iniquity connected with di sanctuary. You and your pikin man dem with you go bear di iniquity connected with your priesthood.

Bring with you also your brothers di tribe of Levi, di tribe of your papa, so that dem go join with you, and minister to you, but you and your pikin man dem with you go be before di Tent of di testimony.
Dem go keep your charge, and di charge of all di Tent. Only dem no go come near to di furnishings of di sanctuary and to di altar, so that dem no go die, neither una.
Dem go join with you, and keep di charge of di Tent of Meeting, for all di service of di Tent. No stranger go come near to una.
Una go keep di charge of di sanctuary, and di charge of di altar, so that dere go no longer dey wrath on di pikin dem of Israel.
I, look, I don take una brothers di Levites from among di pikin dem of Israel. Dem na gift to una, given to di Lord, to do di service of di Tent of Meeting.

You and your pikin man dem with you go keep your priesthood for everything of di altar, and for wetin dey inside di veil. Una go serve. I give una di priesthood as one service of gift. Di stranger wey come near go dey put to death.”

Di Lord speak to Aaron, “Look, I myself don give you di charge of my heave offerings, even all di holy things of di pikin dem of Israel. I don give dem to you by reason of di anointing, and to your pikin man dem, as one portion forever.

Dis go be yours of di most holy things, reserved from di fire: every offering of dem, even every meal offering of dem, and every sin offering of dem, and every trespass offering of dem, wey dem go render to me, go be most holy for you and for your pikin man dem.
Una go eat am as di most holy things. Every male go eat am. E go be holy to you.

Dis too na yours: di heave offering of dem gift, even all di wave offerings of di pikin dem of Israel. I don give dem to you, and to your pikin man dem and to your pikin woman dem with you, as one portion forever. Everyone wey dey clean for your house go eat of am.
All di best of di oil, and all di best of di vintage, and of di grain, di firstfruits of dem wey dem give to di Lord, I don give dem to you.
Di first ripe fruits of all wey dey for dem land, wey dem bring to di Lord, go be yours. Everyone wey dey clean for your house go eat of am.
Every devoted thing for Israel go be yours.

Everything wey open di womb, of all flesh wey dem offer to di Lord, both of men and animals, go be yours. Nevertheless di firstborn of man you go surely redeem, and di firstborn of unclean animals you go redeem.
Dem wey dem go redeem from one month old you go redeem, according to your valuation, for di money of five shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary, wey be 20 gerahs.

But di firstborn of one cow, or di firstborn of one sheep, or di firstborn of one goat, you no go redeem. Dem dey holy. You go sprinkle dem blood on di altar, and go burn dem fat for one offering made by fire, for pleasing aroma to di Lord.
Dem flesh go be yours, as di wave breast and as di right thigh, e go be yours.

All di heave offerings of di holy things, wey di pikin dem of Israel offer to di Lord, I don give to you, and to your pikin man dem and to your pikin woman dem with you, as one portion forever. E na one covenant of salt forever before di Lord to you and to your seed with you.”
Di Lord speak to Aaron, “You no go get any inheritance for dem land, neither go you get any portion among dem. I na your portion and your inheritance among di pikin dem of Israel.
Look, to di pikin dem of Levi I don give all di tithe for Israel for inheritance, for dem service wey dem serve, even di service of di Tent of Meeting.
Di pikin dem of Israel no go come near di Tent of Meeting again, so that dem no go bear sin, and die.

But di Levites go do di service of di Tent of Meeting, and dem go bear dem iniquity. E go be one statute forever throughout una generations, and among di pikin dem of Israel dem go get no inheritance.

Because di tithe of di pikin dem of Israel, wey dem offer as one heave offering to di Lord, I don give to di Levites for inheritance. Na why I talk to dem say among di pikin dem of Israel dem go get no inheritance.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,

“Moreover you go speak to di Levites, and tell dem, ‘When una take from di pikin dem of Israel di tithe wey I don give una from dem for una inheritance, una go offer up one heave offering of am for di Lord, one tithe of di tithe.
Una heave offering go dey counted to una as di grain of di threshing floor, and as di fullness of di winepress.
Na so una too go offer one heave offering to di Lord of all una tithes, wey una receive from di pikin dem of Israel. Of am una go give di Lord heave offering to Aaron di priest.
Out of all una gifts una go offer every heave offering of di Lord, of all di best of dem, even di holy part of dem.’
Therefore you go talk to dem, ‘When una heave di best of am from am, e go dey counted to di Levites as di increase of di threshing floor, and as di increase of di winepress.
Una go eat am for every place, una and una households, because na una wages for una service for di Tent of Meeting.
Una go bear no sin because of am, when una don heave from am di best of am. Una no go profane di holy things of di pikin dem of Israel, so that una no go die.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses and to Aaron, talk,
“Dis na di statute of di law wey di Lord don command, talk, ‘Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, say make dem bring you one red heifer without blemish, wey no get defect, and wey no don wear yoke.
You go give am to Eleazar di priest, and dem go bring am outside di camp, and one go kill am before am.
Eleazar di priest go take some of im blood with im finger, and sprinkle some of im blood toward di front of di Tent of Meeting seven times.
One go burn di heifer for im sight. Im skin, and im flesh, and im blood, with im dung, e go burn.
Di priest go take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast am into di middle of di burning of di heifer.
Di priest go wash im clothes, and bathe im flesh in water, and after dat e go come into di camp. Di priest go dey unclean until evening.
Im wey burn am go wash im clothes in water, and bathe im flesh in water, and go dey unclean until evening.

One man wey dey clean go gather up di ashes of di heifer, and lay dem up outside di camp for one clean place, and e go dey kept for di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel for water of impurity. E na one sin offering.
Im wey gather di ashes of di heifer go wash im clothes, and dey unclean until evening. E go be to di pikin dem of Israel, and to di stranger wey dey sojourn among dem, for one statute forever.
Im wey touch di dead body of any man go dey unclean seven days.
Dat person go purify imself with water on di third day, and for di seventh day e go dey clean. But if e no purify imself di third day, di seventh day e no go dey clean.

Whoever touch di dead body of any man wey don die, and no purify imself, defile di tabernacle of di Lord. Dat soul go dey cut off from Israel, because di water of impurity no dey sprinkled on am. E go dey unclean. Im uncleanness dey still on am.
Dis na di law when one man die for one tent: everyone wey come into di tent, and everyone wey dey inside di tent, go dey unclean seven days.
Every open vessel, wey no get covering bound on am, dey unclean.
Whoever for di open field touch one wey dey slain by sword, or one dead body, or one bone of man, or one grave, go dey unclean seven days.
For di unclean person dem go take of di ashes of di burnt sin offering, and running water go dey added to dem for one vessel.

One clean person go take hyssop, and dip am for di water, and sprinkle am on di tent, and on all di vessels, and on di persons wey dey dere, and on am wey touch di bone, or di slain, or di dead, or di grave.
Di clean person go sprinkle on di unclean on di third day, and on di seventh day. For di seventh day e go purify am. E go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and e go dey clean for evening.

But di man wey dey unclean, and no purify imself, dat soul go dey cut off from among di assembly, because e don defile di sanctuary of di Lord. Di water of impurity no dey sprinkled on am. E dey unclean.
E go be one perpetual statute to dem. Im wey sprinkle di water of impurity go wash im clothes. Im wey touch di water of impurity go dey unclean until evening.
Whatever di unclean person touch go dey unclean. Di soul wey touch am go dey unclean until evening.’”
Di pikin dem of Israel, even all di congregation, come into di wilderness of Zin for di first month. Di people stay for Kadesh. Miriam die dere, and dem bury am dere.
Dere no dey water for di congregation, and dem assemble demself together against Moses and against Aaron.
Di people quarrel with Moses, and speak, talk, “We for don die when our brothers die before di Lord!
Why una don bring di Lord assembly into dis wilderness, so that we and our animals go die dere?
Why una don make us come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to dis evil place? E no be place of grain, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates. Neither e get water to drink.”
Moses and Aaron go from di presence of di assembly to di door of di Tent of Meeting, and fall on dem faces. Di glory of di Lord appear to dem.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,

“Take di rod, and assemble di congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to di rock before dem, so that e go yield im water. Na so you go bring forth to dem water out of di rock, and go give di congregation and dem livestock drink.”
Moses take di rod from before di Lord, as e command am.
Moses and Aaron gather di assembly together before di rock, and e talk to dem, “Hear now, una rebels! Make we bring una water out of dis rock?”
Moses lift up im hand, and strike di rock with im rod twice. Water come out abundantly, and di congregation drink, and dem livestock.
Di Lord talk to Moses and Aaron, “Because una no believe me, to make me holy for di eyes of di pikin dem of Israel, therefore una no go bring dis assembly into di land wey I don give dem.”
Dis na di waters of Meribah, because di pikin dem of Israel quarrel with di Lord, and e dey made holy among dem.
Moses send messengers from Kadesh to di king of Edom, “Your brother Israel talk so: ‘You know all di hardship wey don befall us,
how our papa dem go down into Egypt, and we dwell for Egypt one long time. Di Egyptians mistreat us and our papa dem.
When we cry to di Lord, e hear our voice, and send one angel, and bring us out of Egypt. Look, we dey for Kadesh, one city for di edge of your border.

Edom talk to am, “You no go pass through me, otherwise I go come out with di sword against you.”
Di pikin dem of Israel talk to am, “We go go up by di highway. If we drink of your water, I and my livestock, I go pay for am. Make I only pass through on my feet, without doing anything else.”
E talk, “You no go pass through.” Edom come out against am with much people, and with one strong hand.
So Edom refuse to give Israel passage through im border, and Israel turn away from am.
Dem journey from Kadesh, and di pikin dem of Israel, even all di congregation, come to Mount Hor.
Di Lord speak to Moses and Aaron for Mount Hor, by di border of di land of Edom, talk,
“Aaron go dey gathered to im people, because e no go enter into di land wey I don give to di pikin dem of Israel, because una rebel against my word for di waters of Meribah.
Take Aaron and Eleazar im pikin, and bring dem up to Mount Hor.
Strip Aaron of im garments, and put dem on Eleazar im pikin. Aaron go dey gathered to im people, and go die dere.”
Moses do as di Lord command, and dem go up into Mount Hor for di sight of all di congregation.
Moses strip Aaron of im garments, and put dem on Eleazar im pikin. Aaron die dere on di top of di mountain. Moses and Eleazar come down from di mountain.
When all di congregation see say Aaron don die, all di house of Israel mourn for Aaron 30 days.
